name: Authenticator — TOTP/HOTP Vault
description: Secure 2FA authenticator. Generates TOTP/HOTP codes from an AES-256-GCM encrypted local vault. 100% private & client-side.

_permission_justifications.storage: Required to persist the encrypted vault (AES-256-GCM ciphertext + KDF salt/IV) in chrome.storage.local. We deliberately do NOT use localStorage, which is accessible to page scripts.
_permission_justifications.alarms: Required to implement periodic TOTP tick (every 30 s) and idle-timeout auto-lock in the non-persistent MV3 service worker. chrome.alarms is the only reliable timer API that survives service worker suspension.
_permission_justifications.clipboardWrite: Required to copy the OTP code to clipboard on explicit user click. The user initiates every copy action; this permission is NOT used silently.
_permission_justifications.activeTab: Required for QR code scanning: captures the current tab visible area via chrome.tabs.captureVisibleTab when the user clicks 'Scan QR from Current Tab' in the popup to decode a 2FA QR code without camera permissions. Invoked strictly on explicit user gesture and limited to the active tab.
_permission_justifications.idle: Required to detect when the browser becomes idle so the vault can be auto-locked after the user-configured timeout (default 5 minutes). This is a security-critical feature.
